topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well now, this be a curious thing, indeed! Found a box in the earth, where no man recalls putting it. Dug it up with the spade, thinking it might be a cache of old coins or something, but found it stuffed with papers and trinkets most peculiar. I showed it to the blacksmith; he reckons some of the bits are older than the village church. Never seen such things, and to think, they were right under our noses all this time, hidden in the good earth. It’s like a gift from the past, come to surprise us on a chilly autumn morn. Might be time to fetch the priest and see what wisdom he can glean from these old treasures. A fine day it is, with the sun warming the fields and the air sweet with the scent of turning leaves.
